label: TSV360 74-video full queries with cross-video agreement additions

provenance.source: TSV360 saliency GT on 111 matched MP4 videos
provenance.frame_to_time: decoded frame best_effort_timestamp_time; end is next frame PTS

dense_gpt_recalibration.method: global 4 FPS scan plus adaptive denser focused scan

cross_video_agreement.scope: all original queries for videos whose dense review finished for both judges; cross-video additions applied where available
cross_video_agreement.sampling: 2 FPS panorama plus six rectilinear views
cross_video_agreement.agreement: Every stored label from both judges is positive, and consecutive samples are at most 0.55s apart
cross_video_agreement.eligible_pairs: coarse candidate or uncertain pairs with both judges labeling every 2 FPS frame
cross_video_agreement.asset_grain: full target video; agreed sample intervals are retained in additions.json

merge_full_queries.rule: Keep the 74 dual-judge-finished videos; include every original query whose source video is in that set; replace overlapping queries with the agreement release so cross-video additions are preserved
